Panicum has far more species. It is a large genus of about 450 species, while Populus has only about 25–35 species.

Panicum (panicgrass) consists of grasses native throughout the tropical regions of the world, with a few species extending into the northern temperate zone. Populus is a genus of deciduous flowering trees, including poplar, aspen, and cottonwood, native to most of the Northern Hemisphere.
